domain.emitted_calls: forward_functional; out= and mutation rejected by functional_domain.py
domain.dtype_domain_meaning: eager semantic candidates; device compilation support recorded separately,not silently filtered
domain.generator_shapes: unchanged upstream semantic specifications; no decision-specific shape generator
domain.input_values: per-sample seeded normal floating/complex,0..1 integral/bool; shared value-domain screen rejects unsafe combinations without repair
domain.binding_parameters: only registered shape,dtype,layout actions; topology and other semantic parameters frozen

unknowns: Unknown reachability/membership remains in the target set. This is measured coverage of a declared source universe, not the fraction of all feasible compiler/kernel paths. Unattributed events are unknown and never hits.
numerator_population: all legal-input compilation attempts, including verified decisions reached before later compilation failure; also report successful-execution-only hits separately
invalidations: any attributed hit of a proved-excluded outcome
actual proof-function entry facts fail fixed CUDA/noncomplex assumptions
invalidations_action: stop inference under this protocol, retain failures and costs, audit and create a new version; never silently enlarge denominator or remove hard targets
